title: Practice 1: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Лодка ___ (отплыть) от берега и вскоре исчезла в тумане.
exercises.prompt: The boat floated away from the shore and soon disappeared into the fog.
exercises.why: Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: ходить, ездить, летать usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb. However, prefixes "по-" and "с-" may form the perfective aspect with the "repeated function" verbs. Prefix "по-" denoting a perfective action of limited duration (an action "for a while"): походить, поездить, полетать. *Он походил по комнате и сел за стол. Мы поездили по городу и поехали домой.* b) Prefix "с-" implying a single round trip: сходить, съездить, слетать. These verbs denote a single trip (going to and coming from a place), especially when a quick return is implied. *Мне надо сходить на почту за письмами. Я съезжу… — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: ходить, ездить, летать usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 63)
